_header.dataset: styxx BENCH-1 PR-claim dataset (INVALID; superseded by BENCH-2)
_header.supersedes: BENCH-1, declared INVALID by its own audit gate (RESULT_bench1_INVALID_2026_09_17.md)
_header.status: BENCH-1 was declared INVALID by its own blocking audit gate: 30 of 50 hand-audited items disagreed with the oracle. Published so the failure is inspectable.
_header.license: CC-BY-4.0, inherited from AIDev. Attribution required.
_header.what_is_here: one row per extracted claim: the pull request URL, the agent, the claim kind, the claim sentence and its parsed detail, the sha256 and byte length of the live diff GitHub served, and bench2_oracle.py's ground-truth label with the facts behind it.
_header.what_is_deliberately_absent: styxx's own verdict on each pull request. We do not publish accusations against third parties' pull requests; hand adjudication found 9 of our 11 accusations on this claim kind were wrong (RESULT_bench2_INVALID_2026_09_17.md), which is a further reason not to. Anyone can regenerate them in one command -- see bench_reproduce.py -- and we would rather you did that than take ours on trust.
_header.diffs: not redistributed. Each row carries the URL and the diff's sha256 so anyone can re-fetch from patch-diff.githubusercontent.com and verify byte-for-byte that they have what we read.
_header.reproduce: python bench_reproduce.py --fetch   # re-fetches the diffs, checks each sha256, re-runs the oracle, and optionally scores any checker you point it at.
